PRD-C062: 3 permission key(s) under this module name another module in their second segment (build:timesheets:view, build:timesheets:create, build:timesheets:manage) and access-policy.ts resolves entitlement from the first segment alone, so they bill against build. An org that buys timesheets without build gets a 402 naming the wrong product. Fix by migrating the keys or declaring the namespace in administersNamespaces.
